title: Watchlist CRUD endpoints — non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #102 (api-watchlist), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: backend/openapi.json gained the /api/watchlist routes/schemas in PR #102 but frontend/src/api/types.ts was never regenerated (still has zero watchlist references) — the add-api-endpoint skill explicitly lists 'regenerate after every snapshot update so the two sides can't silently drift' as a required step and flags skipping it as a named common failure mode, and the precedent api-stocks-indicator-history PR (also backend-only at the time) did regenerate types.ts. Not treated as blocking here since CLAUDE.md's own wording allows deferring frontend type regen until 'before the frontend consumes the change' and no frontend watchlist consumer exists yet, but regenerate frontend/src/api/types.ts (npm run generate:api-types) before or alongside whatever task first builds a frontend watchlist UI, rather than leaving it to be discovered as a surprise stale-types diff then.

backend/app/api/routers/watchlist.py's _compute_signal calls drop_malformed_daily_bars(daily_ohlcv) before analyse(), but analyse() already performs this exact filtering internally as its first step (app/signals/engine.py) -- and unlike stocks.py's get_analysis (which needs the pre-filtered frame afterward to derive as_of), _compute_signal never uses the returned daily_ohlcv for anything else, so this is a redundant full-DataFrame pass per watched ticker on every GET /api/watchlist request. Not a correctness bug (idempotent operation), just wasted work -- drop the redundant call and let analyse() do it once.

The nullable-signal-on-failure tests (test_watchlist.py) cover TickerNotFoundError and DataProviderUnavailableError but not InsufficientHistoryError specifically, even though all three are the DataProviderError subclasses the decisions entry names as triggering the null-out. Behavior is verified generically since _compute_signal catches the shared base class, but add a spot-test for the InsufficientHistoryError case too for completeness/documentation value.

No test exercises WatchlistItemIn's ticker field being real content padded with leading/trailing whitespace (e.g. ' aapl ' -> 'AAPL') -- only the blank-whitespace-only rejection and already-clean-casing paths are tested, so the strip-then-uppercase interaction for a realistic 'user pasted a ticker with a stray space' input isn't directly covered.
